title: --apply-workflows retrofit flag + plugin command
description:
Human-requested (2026-06-12): already-initialized projects NEVER receive newly-shipped workflows — the already_initialized branch of bin/init.js skips materializeWorkflows by design, so every project initialized with plugin <= 0.2.0 will miss deep-review/deep-research after a plugin update. Close the gap with a surgical re-apply path, following the TASK-036 --apply-models precedent exactly.

SHAPE (locked with the human):
(a) bin/init.js gains an --apply-workflows flag: reads NOTHING from the wizard, runs ONLY materializeWorkflows against the target project (created/forced/resumed/already_initialized state is irrelevant — the flag bypasses the state machine the way --apply-models does). Preserves the materializer's never-overwrite contract: existing files in .claude/workflows/ are left untouched; only missing files are added. Prints a one-line summary of files added / skipped.
(b) New plugin command commands/apply-workflows.md (namespaced /hivemind:apply-workflows): runs node \${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/dist/init.cjs --apply-workflows and reports the result. Follow the structure of commands/task-status.md (thin, bash-driven, no TTY assumptions).
(c) Rebuild dist/ (npm run build:plugin) in the same change; reviewer checks byte-fresh.
(d) Coordinate with TASK-039: if 039's subdirectory-filter and warn-wrapper land first, this flag inherits them for free. Sequencing preference: 039 -> 038 -> 040, but the flag must work regardless of order.

NOTE: /hivemind:init-project remains the fresh-project bootstrap; this command is the upgrade/retrofit path. Document the distinction in one sentence inside the command body.
acceptance_criteria: node bin/init.js --apply-workflows on an ALREADY-INITIALIZED project adds any missing workflow files to .claude/workflows/ without touching PROJECT.md, tasks/, agents, skills, or any existing workflow file (never-overwrite preserved); exits non-zero with a clear message only on real I/O failure.

The flag works on a NOT-yet-initialized project too (no crash: it simply materializes workflows; it does NOT run the wizard), and is mutually understood with the state machine: no PROJECT.md is created, no session bundle is minted.

commands/apply-workflows.md exists at plugin root, runs the dist bundle with the flag via \${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}, and states in one sentence that init-project is for fresh projects while apply-workflows retrofits workflow files after plugin updates.

Regression locks: one e2e spec proving the retrofit on an initialized tmp project (missing file added, existing file untouched, PROJECT.md byte-identical pre/post) and one proving the not-initialized no-wizard path; dist/ rebuilt and committed byte-fresh.
CLI parse errors for conflicting flags (--apply-workflows combined with --force or --answers-file) reject with a clear message before any filesystem write.

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: PLAN-TIME TIER ASSIGNMENT: verification_tier = tests-after. CLI flag + file-copy glue provable by running (the --apply-models precedent ran the same way); regression locks named in AC4. ACs human-observable (run the command on a real initialized project) so the UAT step applies: live /hivemind:apply-workflows on an existing project after the command ships. Scaled gate: test:changed + init/init-command/workflows-materializer/plugin-deps e2e.

comments.author: uat
comments.body: UAT 2026-06-12 (tier tests-after, human-observable). Step 1 (initialized retrofit) — FAIL on user-facing output. Ran the REAL bundle binary: CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=<tmp> node dist/init.cjs --apply-workflows against an initialized project missing deep-research.js with a user-edited deep-review.js. FILESYSTEM correct: deep-research.js added, deep-review.js byte-identical (user edit preserved), no PROJECT.md created, no state/ bundle minted. BUT stdout printed, after the correct summary line, THREE FALSE lines: "* PROJECT.md written to <tmp>/PROJECT.md", "* Session bundle: state/sessions/null/", "Next step: start a chat...". Root cause: printFriendlyOutcome (bin/init.js:664) early-returns for already_initialized but has NO case for the applied_workflows state, so it falls through to the normal-init epilogue — printing a PROJECT.md-written claim and a literal state/sessions/null/ bundle path that never happened. Invisible to the e2e specs because they assert on runInit return value + filesystem, never stdout. Steps 2 (uninitialized no-wizard) + 5 (exclusivity) remain PASS (spec-proven + reviewer plant-test). VERDICT: back to developer for the printFriendlyOutcome fix + a stdout regression lock. Re-UAT after.

comments.author: uat
comments.body: RE-UAT 2026-06-12 after fix 038c83e. Step 1 (initialized retrofit) — PASS: ran the real bundle binary again; stdout now shows ONLY "--apply-workflows: 1 file(s) added (deep-research.js); 1 file(s) already present and skipped (deep-review.js)." — no false "PROJECT.md written", no "state/sessions/null", no "Next step:". Filesystem still correct (file added, existing preserved, no PROJECT.md, no bundle). Step 2 (uninitialized no-wizard) PASS (spec + reviewer plant-test). Step 3 (command file) PASS verified by Orchestrator (commands/apply-workflows.md invokes node ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/dist/init.cjs --apply-workflows, task-status.md structure, init-project distinction sentence present). Step 5 (exclusivity) PASS. OVERALL: PASS (all ACs). The first UAT FAIL (false stdout epilogue) is fixed + locked by a stdout sensor; the twin in --apply-models rolled to TASK-044.

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: CLOSE: APPROVE (fresh-context review, 0 HIGH / 0 MEDIUM / 2 LOW) + UAT (1 FAIL caught live → fixed → RE-UAT PASS). Commits 4304f35 (impl) + 038c83e (UAT-fix: printFriendlyOutcome false-epilogue suppression + stdout regression lock). The live UAT earned its keep: it caught a false-stdout defect (printFriendlyOutcome had no applied_workflows case → printed PROJECT.md-written + state/sessions/null) that the fresh-context review AND the full e2e suite both missed because no spec asserted CLI stdout. Fix red-green proven by the developer (new stdout lock fails against pre-fix bundle) and re-verified live by the orchestrator; dist byte-fresh. Twin defect in --apply-models (TASK-036) → TASK-044. The --apply-workflows retrofit is now live: existing projects get newly-shipped workflows via /hivemind:apply-workflows after a plugin update.
